mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent GDP contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE spike does not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO surge does not correlate with subsequent GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPIAUCSL is above 2% YoY, the real interest rate is negative, signaling accommodative monetary policy and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent equity market outperformance.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals robust demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is also declining, it signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 consecutive quarters and INDPRO declining
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of negative GDPC1 and declining INDPRO does not correlate with subsequent equity market underperformance.
